import axios from'axios';const API_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://localhost:5001/api';const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_URL});// Attach JWT token to every request if available

export const getProperties=params=>api.get('/properties',{params});export const getProperty=id=>api.get(`/properties/${id}`);export const createProperty=data=>api.post('/properties',data);export const deleteProperty=id=>api.delete(`/properties/${id}`);export const getMyListings=()=>api.get('/properties/my/listings');// ── Search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
